knowledge_graph.title: Compass. Therapy. Support. Community
knowledge_graph.merchant_description: "We are a local charity that supports people with Multiple Sclerosis (MS) and other neurological conditions such as ME / Chronic Fatigue, Parkinson’s, Fibromyalgia, Stroke, traumatic brain injury, chronic migraines and Long Covid. We provide a range of subsidised therapies including oxygen therapy, physiotherapy and a variety of complementary therapies."
